alt: Two boxes labelled Game patch and PS5 system update, both marked as needed.

data.title: Two updates, both needed

cards.title: Game patch
cards.body: The day-one patch for Grand Theft Auto VI. Check for it from the game's Options menu or the Xbox queue.

cards.title: PS5 system update
cards.body: A separate PS5 system software update is required before you play. It is not the same as the game patch.

data.note: Pre-loading the game does not install the PS5 system update.
